title: Condition on complete preparation histories before asserting independent resource quality
statement: Actual completed review accepts history-uniform purification for the specified IID four-spin source family, heterogeneous SWAP checks, finite integer schedules and conditional cost/cap bounds. Full successful preparation histories preserve the certified isotropic quality envelope under capped retries; they do not preserve equality of actual conditional errors. A valid contamination bound and source-family membership are additional promises. The old noisy-purification manuscript has only its separate cost lemma accepted with its boundary erratum; do not accept all older diagnostics. Output batches need separate complete histories and reset controls for product independence. Timeout can alter the actual conditional law; no arbitrary source memory, future readiness or protected hardware follows.
